mapper.sql: select mu.`id`, mu.`terminal_id`, mu.`category_id`, mu.`code`, mu.`name`, mu.`icon`, mu.`path`, mu.`sort`, mu.`level`, mu.`remark`, mu.`enabled`, mu.`parent_id`, mu.`sequence`, mu.`deleted`, mu.`create_by`, mu.`create_time`, mu.`update_by`, mu.`update_time` from `menu` mu
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT f.`id` `id`, f.`name` `name`, f.icon `icon`, f.`application_group_id` `applicationGroupId`, f.`code` `code`, g.`name` `applicationGroupName` FROM `menu` a LEFT JOIN `ouaa_role_menu` b ON a.`id` = b.`menu_id` LEFT JOIN `user_role` c ON b.`role_id` = c.`role_id` LEFT JOIN `product_application` e ON e.`application_id` = b.`application_id` LEFT JOIN `tenant_product` d ON d.`product_id` = e.`product_id` LEFT JOIN `application` f ON f.`id` = e.`application_id` LEFT JOIN `application_group` g ON g.`id` = f.`application_group_id` WHERE a.`path` = #{path} and c.`user_id` = #{userId} and d.`tenant` = #{tenant}
